fields.label: API User
fields.description: A restricted-role user whose API Key/Secret the React frontend uses for write calls (checkout, etc). Created and scoped in Step 3.

fields.label: Enable Guest Catalog Access
fields.description: Allow the item/price catalog and theme/content endpoints to be read without login, so the storefront can render for anonymous visitors.

fields.label: Default Price List
fields.description: Which ERPNext Price List the storefront's item prices are read from (e.g. Standard Selling).

fields.label: Allowed Frontend Origins
fields.description: One origin per line, e.g. https://shop.dpono.com - this server's frontend domain(s) allowed to call the API.
